title: POC combined extractor output
description: Combined output of the POC skills and technologies extractors. Each extractor's extract() returns a sorted list[str]: SkillExtractor.extract(text) (src/poc/skills/extract_skills_a.py) takes raw text, and TechExtractor.extract(doc) (src/poc/technologies/extract_technologies_a.py) takes a spaCy Doc, not raw text. Both return sorted, deduplicated, lowercase strings, and both return an empty list on error. TechExtractor.extract(doc) returns an empty list only when its doc.ents loop raises; a failure in the nlp(text) parse is caught by CombinedExtractor.extract (src/poc/integration_adapter.py), which sets technologies to an empty list. Invariants that JSON Schema cannot express are stated in the field descriptions: every array is sorted ascending (case-insensitive; all values are lowercase, so plain string order applies), and contains no duplicates.

skills.description: Skill phrases from SkillExtractor.extract(text). Must be sorted ascending case-insensitively, all lowercase, and deduplicated. May be empty.

items.description: Lowercase skill phrase, produced by span.text.replace('\n', ' ').strip().lower().

technologies.description: Technology names from TechExtractor.extract(doc). Must be sorted ascending case-insensitively, all lowercase, and deduplicated. May be empty.

items.description: Lowercase technology name, taken from TECH entity text.
